product.title: Helicopter tour in Rio de Janeiro - 25 Minutes

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this 25-minute helicopter flight departs the Jacarepaguá helipad on Avenida Ayrton Senna in Barra da Tijuca after a safety briefing. The published aerial route looks over Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana Beach, Ipanema Beach, and Sugar Loaf Mountain. The outing stays on the flight window rather than adding a ground city circuit or cable-car ticket. Pilot commentary covers the granite peaks and South Zone shoreline from above. The format suits visitors who want a short guided aerial window without booking a full-day van loop. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on the Jacarepaguá helipad and the Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana, Ipanema, and Sugar Loaf views that define this flight rather than a Pedra Bonita hang-gliding launch.

highlights: 25-minute helicopter circuit over Christ the Redeemer, Copacabana, Ipanema, and Sugar Loaf
Departure from the Jacarepaguá helipad in Barra da Tijuca
Aerial views of the South Zone beaches and granite peaks
Published duration stays on the flight window rather than a full-day city circuit

start.description: Meet at the Jacarepaguá helipad, Av. Ayrton Senna 2541, Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, for the published safety briefing before boarding.

end.description: Return to your Rio de Janeiro meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
